caption: A man with short dark hair and a goatee, wearing a white polo shirt, sits behind a black table against a black backdrop, speaking and gesturing throughout. In front of him rest a clear glass of water with a yellow straw leaning inside, a petri dish of yellow liquid with a small metal object on its edge, and a small glass of yellow liquid at the right frame edge. His gaze starts downward toward the water glass before shifting to look directly at the camera. Both hands move continuously, palms open and raised with fingers spread, then lowering; later his torso tilts forward and his head cocks. The right hand curls into a loose partial fist while the left stays open, after which both hands open wide again with palms up. His upper body leans slightly forward and back as he talks. The objects on the table remain in place, the straw keeping its angle in the water. The camera framing and background appear unchanged.
